# sanity_cors_origin (Resource)

Manages a Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) origin for a Sanity project. Allows web applications (like Sanity Studio or your frontend) to make authenticated or unauthenticated requests to the Sanity API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Add frontend application origin
resource "sanity_cors_origin" "frontend" {
  project_id        = sanity_project.example.id
  origin            = "https://my-app.example.com"
  allow_credentials = false
}

# Add local development studio origin with credentials allowed
resource "sanity_cors_origin" "local_studio" {
  project_id        = sanity_project.example.id
  origin            = "http://localhost:3333"
  allow_credentials = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `origin` (String) The URL origin including scheme and optional port (e.g. `https://my-app.com` or `http://localhost:3000`).
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Sanity project to configure CORS for.

### Optional

- `allow_credentials` (Boolean) Whether to allow requests with credentials (cookies, authorization headers). Required for Sanity Studio login.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the CORS origin was created.
- `id` (Number) The internal numeric identifier assigned by Sanity (e.g. `3294326`).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the CORS origin was last updated.
